places.name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf - Dairy Farm Mall
places.address: 4 Dairy Farm Ln, #01-01/02 Dairy Farm Mall, Singapore 677622

reviews.author: CC
reviews.text: This is my favourite Coffee Bean at Dairy Farm. Staffs and Manager are extremely friendly and efficient. Great service standard by staff MiMi who always greets us with a smile at 9.25am every Saturday. Thank you for providing this awesome dinning experience.

reviews.author: Bren A
reviews.text:
Drinks are fine. But if you're ordering food here....... erm.
I got the mushroom and chicken fusilli and it was quite.. sauceless. We asked if we could have a bit more sauce, and the staff said that it was their "SOP" and they give a certain ml of sauce. Not sure i see any though? I wonder if it's also their SOP where the chicken is rock hard? And it's like garlic pasta.
I used to like this pasta here, but i guess not anymore. :(

reviews.author: edtayjb
reviews.text:
This TCBTL outlet is by far one of my favourite places to have a nice Western breakfast in air-conditioned comfort - especially with its recurring promotional 2 breakfast sets. I also like the crew at this outlet - they are friendly and helpful. And the ambience here is so very very "chill."

UPDATE OF 19 JUNE 2026
I was here today with a friend to have coffee at this, my favourite TCBTL outlet for its ambience, service and food and beverages. We had a Latte and a Cappuccino. Both hot beverages were very good as always at TCBTL.

UPDATE OF 15 AUGUST 2026
I was here yesterday evening with my wife and our 2 friends for some beverages and desserts after dinner nearby. I tried yesterday evening for the first time, a Watermelon Mint Lychee beverage. It was very good and very refreshingly moreish.

reviews.author: Patricia Lim
reviews.text:
New cafe in Dairy Farm Mall.
Pleasant and spacious.
Love their counter look and the staff on duty was very pleasant.

However, the wafer is not nice. Abit too cool  and hard for my preference.  The eggs are fantastically done. Coffee is nice too.

reviews.author: Ab
reviews.text: Nice addition to the Dairy Farm Mall! It’s brand new so atmosphere is clean and modern! Good consistency of service and food provided. Usually plenty of seats regardless of timing I’m there. Only gripe would be that there are no PowerPoints!

places.name: Hangar66 Cafe
places.address: 66 Seletar Aerospace View, #66 Level 1 WOA Aviation Hangar, Singapore 797509

reviews.author: HEE Chee Kong
reviews.text:
Great Food, Generous Portions & Lovely Dining Experience!

Had a wonderful dining experience at W Playground Cafe! A great place to enjoy a hearty meal with family and friends, with a good variety of Western dishes and sides.

We ordered quite a few dishes, including mushroom pasta, prawn aglio olio, crispy fried calamari, fried chicken wings, BBQ pork ribs, fresh salad and truffle fries.

The prawn aglio olio looked especially appetising, with generously sized prawns, while the mushroom pasta was nicely presented with plenty of mushrooms. The crispy calamari and fried chicken wings were great choices for sharing, especially with the sweet chilli dipping sauce.

The BBQ pork ribs were another highlight, served in a generous portion with a rich, glossy BBQ sauce. The salad added a refreshing balance to the meal, and the truffle fries topped with a generous amount of shaved cheese were definitely tempting!

Overall, a satisfying dining experience with good food variety, generous portions and attractive presentation. A nice spot for a casual gathering, family meal or simply catching up with friends.

Worth visiting, and happy to come back again to try more dishes!

reviews.author: Julia Lee
reviews.text: ​We had a wonderful dining experience at Hangar 66 and were thoroughly impressed with the quality of the food. We started our meal with their creamy mushroom soup, which was rich and flavorful, topped with perfectly crunchy croutons. For the main courses, the grilled salmon was a standout. It featured an incredibly crispy skin and was served on a bed of smooth pumpkin purée, with a fresh kale salad on the side. The flavors were perfectly balanced. The grilled chicken was also delicious—tender and juicy, with two generous sides of corn and a savory gravy. And you absolutely have to try the baked cheese macaroni.it was incredibly cheesy, with a satisfyingly bubbly, golden-brown top. Every dish was prepared with care. We can't wait to come back and try more! Most importantly, the staffs are so friendly and welcoming too.

reviews.author: Doris Chong
reviews.text:
Food was really pretty legit. We ordered the lunch set that came with smoky duck pasta + grilled chicken + soup (we chose 🍄) and dessert (we chose tiramisu). Drinks not included.

The lychee peach mojito was really delish. But the most delectable one was still the smoky duck pasta. I usually don't like it when it's creamy, but Hangar66 nailed it 💯

It's pretty inaccessible, gotta take a bus (35 min) and walk 10 minutes from the bus stop. Nonetheless, given the food and view, I'd say it's still worth a trip.

Total damage for 3 pax: $78+
Visited: 6/8/26 (Thurs) around 3 pm.

reviews.author: Spike378
reviews.text:
Food was very delicious at priced very reasonably too! The staff were very friendly and our food came relatively quick. The aviation theme for this cafe is pretty cool and you get a chance to see the real plane hangars beside the cafe through the glass.

It is a bit hard to get here though if you do not have a car.

reviews.author: Naklapas Watcharapariyapas
reviews.text:
The kid's meal was a great portion. The grilled pork was soft and easy to chew. Salad is crunchy
Squid ink pasta is delicious and refreshing, especially with a pomelo garnish.

Wagyu steak can be better  (medium rare) …
And mushroom soup (please cook with care)

The restaurant has a lot of space

reviews.author: Tan Danny
reviews.text: Always check your orders from this drive thru branch. Ordered spicy nuggets. Gave normal nuggets. Charge you additional sauce, missed out on curry sauce

reviews.author: michael lin
reviews.text: Got the Honey mustard McCrispy Feast for $9.90 deal and quality was surprisingly decent. Everything was good except the fries.  I had the meal about 10mins walk away, and by the time I had the fries they were cold and not crispy. Not the end of the world but just wasn’t as enjoyable.

reviews.author: Flo Y.
reviews.text: This outlet serves as a quick and straightforward option for a convenient fast-food meal. While it reliably hits the spot for a fast fix, I’ve noticed a tendency for the fried items to arrive slightly overcooked—specifically the Chicken McCrispy in the past and the hash browns more recently. Despite this, the service remains practical for the area, and our latest Deliveroo order was impressively efficient, arriving within just 30 minutes.

reviews.author: gracie
reviews.text: Acap always makes the experience at this macs great!! He is always friendly and helps with any questions or asks. you know there will be good service with Acap serving you. I go quite often, and everytime he always is cheerful and incredibly helpful thank you Acap!

reviews.author: Robin
reviews.text: It may be new but it’s worst McDonald’s in Singapore. Fries are refried, like oily cardboard. Items were missing from the takeout bag. A real shocker. Check your items and demand better. Or go elsewhere

reviews.author: JLYH
reviews.text: Packed on Sunday 7pm but there are still seats, likely due to the haze. All our orders were accurate (special requests like no sauce, no lettuce - all correct) and tasty (cheeseburger, filet o fish, quarter pounder, mcchicken, nuggets, mcwings, iced milo, hot milo, fries, mcflurry, sundae, chococone. Restaurant did forget our mcwings but compensated quickly when we asked for the mcwings. Kitchen was hard at work due to the crazy amount of orders. Service is pretty good considering how hectic dinner service is and so many people waiting for their food. Restaurant interior quite clean, but area near washrooms have damp floors, can be hazardous. Love that the alfresco area has ample ceiling fans, it's breezy and cool even after a hot afternoon.

reviews.author: elvin chiam
reviews.text:
The burger is so dry, barely has any sauce on it.
When approach the staff, she said already put 1 pump. Seriously ? Is more like 1 drop, so disappointed.

Sauces were not refilled, dirty floors and tables while they have a lot of manpowers walking around and chatting.

reviews.author: Zy
reviews.text:
One of the best fast food chains in Singapore. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Honestly, McDonald’s at Bishan Park is such a good place to eat .Like, sometimes you just want a good meal without having to overthink where to go, and this is exactly the kind of place that comes to mind. McDonald’s is already a classic, but having it near Bishan Park makes it even more convenient, especially when you’re out enjoying the park or just hanging around the Bishan area.

The food is one of the main reasons why McDonald’s is so popular. The burgers, fries, chicken and drinks give you plenty of choices, whether you’re really hungry or just craving a quick snack. And honestly, you can never really go wrong with a familiar McDonald’s meal when you’re in the mood for fast food. Sometimes the simplest meals hit the hardest

I also like the idea of having a McDonald’s near a place where people go to walk, relax and spend time with friends or family. You can enjoy the outdoors and then grab something to eat afterwards. It makes the whole outing feel more complete without needing to plan everything.

Overall, I’d definitely consider this McDonald’s if I were around Bishan Park and wanted something convenient and familiar. It’s the kind of place that works for a casual meal, a quick food stop or just satisfying a random McDonald’s craving. Definitely worth considering if you’re in the area! 🍟🍔. There is also an overseeing bridge.

Five stars from me for the overall appeal and convenience! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: AJ M
reviews.text:
Love spending time here. Buy ice cream and just relax with park scenery.
Shout out to Mr.Edward for extra mcdo experience! Dine-in fast food can be entertaining!

reviews.author: salmxyzn
reviews.text:
went in for dinner, and got an amazing service from edward! he started to make animal balloon for little kids and even made one for me and my family while we were waiting for our meal.

though the fries were abit salty, i think it doesnt really matter as edward pretty much made the meal a 10/10 as well as for other kids 💗💗

reviews.author: Laura L
reviews.text:
Our family enjoyed the zi char here! Everything was tasty and the price was ok. It's an outdoor seating area next to the prawning pools. There are some portable aircon fans which keep the area comfortable. We will be back again, hopefully to try some of their other dishes or mookata. Stand out dishes were the curry fish head (very yummy! We added more taukee to ours) and the prawn paste chicken wings. All other dishes were also good. The food came out really fast as well! We were impressed.

Bathrooms were surprisingly large and clean, so that is a bonus for sure.

reviews.author: Bli Leong
reviews.text:
Food was tasty with very flavourful dips and sauces. And prices are very reasonable and cheap.
The only complain is you have to eat in  very hot, stifling and non-airy environment.

reviews.author: Jen Koh
reviews.text:
Hear me out, brothers and sisters. This is hands down my favourite mookata place and honestly, the best I’ve had 😋👍

For the mookata, the meats are super well marinated, soup is very flavourful, quality is consistently good every visit! If you come here in a big group, you can also order zichar (within the same restaurant). We tried the salted egg pork ribs super solid!! must order with rice. Bet I’m coming back with a bigger group to try all other zichar dishes!

The atmosphere is lively and comfortable, service is great, and one huge plus is the ample parking available.

Best of all, the prices are very affordable for the quality and portion sizes. Highly recommend to anyone looking for amazing food and great value!

reviews.author: Alvin Chan
reviews.text:
New place here that they moved to.  Nice cosy environment for prawning, mookata and zhi char.

We had zhi char dishes today, but they should time dishes accordingly like having the cold dish plater first and not be the last dish with desserts.

Otherwise, generally ok.

reviews.author: Chintiong Teo
reviews.text: Located at the ORTO RC at West Coast,the place was surprisingly rather quiet when we arrived at 8pm on a Saturday evening. Spread of the marinated meat and stuff for Mookata experience was kinda usual and price was reasonable. A place that I will not think of for Mookata in the near future unless someone else suggesting it.
